statements.t: The Company plans to continue using feedback from the benchmark to improve its brain, models, and Skills, while advancing their capabilities through physical robot deployments and real-world applications.

The Company reaffirmed its full-year 2026 guidance for the acquired robotics business on a standalone full-year basis: approximately 2,000 robots sold and shipped, with continued positive unit gross margins on robot deliveries.
Brain and Developer Platform: The Company plans to introduce its Physical Cloud technology platform and Productivity Token during CES time period.

By combining its robotics brain and developer platform capabilities, the Company aims to enable education and training institutions and K-12 schools to use robots with different forms and capabilities at a lower cost.

The Company plans to continue developing and refining Skills and technical solutions for different robot forms and industry applications, advancing the deployment of its brain capabilities in real-world scenarios.
Devices : The Company plans to continue growing robot sales and deployments, maintain positive unit gross margins on deliveries, and expand and upgrade FF Robot World.

It subsequently plans to expand RMS capabilities to include management of multiple robot models, mobile operation, and automatic return to the charging dock and resumption of patrols, providing system support for multi-site deployment of its Security and Inspection Solutions.
Data Factory : Plans to continue building capabilities for data collection, processing, annotation, management, quality control, and utilization.

The Company also plans to explore applying FF OmniMind and Skills from the developer platform to rental projects, enabling customers to configure robots for their desired tasks using existing Skills and reducing the need to develop and tune capabilities from scratch.
The Company plans to establish a marketing and sales network covering five states and 30 cities, expanding customer access to its robotics products and solutions.
